title: Discover Roadmap Incomplete
description: Recovery result printed by discover-roadmap-graph --all-roadmaps --with-progress when a rate limit, timeout, or admission deadline interrupts the scan. It is deliberately not a discover-roadmap-union report: it has no roots, leaves, or summary, so a partial row is never a claimable candidate and the missing list is never zero remaining work.

mode.description: Fixed literal naming the scan that was interrupted.

status.description: Fixed literal marking this result as incomplete. A complete union report has no status field.

incomplete.description: Where the scan stopped and how to rerun it safely.

reason.description: Why the scan stopped: a rate limit (real throttle or a load-control cooldown refusal), a request timeout, or an admission deadline that expired while another local process held every slot.

phase.description: The phase in flight when the scan stopped.

lastCompletedPhase.description: The last phase that finished before the scan stopped; null when even root discovery had not finished.

counts.description: Completed and known counts for the phase in flight.

unit.description: What completed and known count: roots or execution-leaf candidates.

completed.description: Items of this phase finished before the scan stopped.

known.description: Items this phase had to do; null while the phase did not yet know its own size (never 0 for unknown).

leavesKnown.description: Execution-leaf candidates discovered so far; null before traversal started. These are not claimable rows.

retryAt.description: ISO time before which a rerun would be refused or throttled again, when the API admission contract or the failure reported one; null otherwise.

retryAtSource.description: server for an observed retry-after or reset, backoff for a local cooldown; null when retryAt is null.

exhausted.description: Always false: an interrupted scan is unknown, never an exhausted inventory.

recovery.description: The safe restart plan: rerun the same full scan, not a resume from partial rows.

safeToRerun.description: Always true: the scan is read-only, so a full rerun is safe.

sameArguments.description: Always true: rerun with the same scope and flags.

notBefore.description: Do not rerun before this ISO time; null when none is known.

arguments.description: The invocation's scope and flags as an argv array, rebuilt from the parsed flags.

cache.description: Additive hint-cache provenance (kurone-kito/idd-skill#3588). Present only when the cache feature is active or a cache flag was passed; complete is always false here because an interrupted scan is never stored.

mode.description: How the run related to the cache: hint (normal read-through), refresh (--refresh-cache), off (--no-cache), or bypass (feature off or caller unidentified while a cache flag was passed).

source.description: Whether this result was computed live in this run.

ageMs.description: Age of the served hint in milliseconds; 0 for a live computation.

maxAgeMs.description: Configured hint freshness window in milliseconds; 0 when no window applies.

complete.description: False for an interrupted scan; such a result is never stored and never proves exhaustion.

enumerations.description: Full discovery enumerations this run performed.

exhaustionRefresh.description: True when a cached report with no startable candidate triggered the single complete refresh before this result.
